senses.gloss: f. (preced.) hard, undeveloped berry, fig, date &c.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:10">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:10">XVII</cite>), 10 <he>פ׳ שטמנה בתבן</he> unripe fruit which one has put in straw; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 2:4:6">Y. Pes. II, 29ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:9:3">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ</cite> (not <he>בטבל</he>); a. e.—

Snh. 107ᵃ אכלה פ׳ he enjoyed her as an unripe fruit (did not wait until she was his legitimate wife). Tanḥ. Vayera 5 איוב בלעה פ׳ Job spoke rashly, opp. בשילה, v. בָּשֵׁל; Gen. R. s. 49 אמר פ׳ (corr. acc.).—Trnsf. undeveloped puberty, childhood.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 5:7">Nidd. V, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00225"><he>בּוֹחַל</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00058"><he>פַּגִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00062"><he>פַּגִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31">Lev. R. s. 31</cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 137:2">Sifré Num. 137</cite>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 137:2">Ib.</cite> <he>פַּגֵּי שביעית</he> bad figs of the Sabbatical year.
